facts: Building semantic edge-to-cloud digital twins from camera footage for urban mobility.
Research pipeline uses guided attention, YOLOv26, planar homography and Kalman filtering for scene understanding/localization.
Publicly reported prototype figures include roughly 1 ms latency, greater than 99.9% data reduction, and about 0.12 m mean coordinate error.
Related work accepted at IEEE GLOBECOM 2026.

experience.organization: NEXTCONLAB / Smart Connected Vehicles Innovation Centre
facts: Worked on drones and UGVs, computer-vision localization, MARL/MAPF, and RF geolocation.
Used phase-difference-of-arrival measurements with ML/RL for rogue base-station localization; public resume figure is about 30 m error.
Developed PANAMA, a network-aware MARL framework for multi-agent path finding in digital-twin environments.

Public resume figures: experiments with 256 agents, greater than 90% success, solution length reduced from roughly 450 to roughly 100, training time around 10% of a cited state-of-the-art baseline, and generalization to about 64x the training-time agent count.
First-author PANAMA work accepted at IEEE GLOBECOM 2025.
Contributed to a U.S. patent-pending method titled Methods and Apparatus For Detecting and Mitigating Hallucinations in Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems.
Public resume reports a multi-agent LLM system improving task accuracy by roughly 50-80% in the evaluated setup.
Built Kotlin, Python and Java backend systems, REST APIs and Supabase-backed services.
Worked on RAG/agent tooling and MCP-style tool integration in a fast startup environment.
Worked with production software, APIs, data systems, fraud modeling, Azure, TensorFlow and applied machine learning.
Worked in an industry software environment before SAS; portfolio only claims public professional experience, not confidential project details.
Worked on audio AI including synthesizer-parameter reconstruction, source separation and signal reconstruction problems.
Built a Twitter sentiment application and CRM-related backend work using Java, Spring Boot, Redis and AWS.
Worked on insurance databases, dashboards, prototypes and production bug fixes.

projects.name: Ottawa Sionna RT Cellular Digital Twin
facts: Outdoor cellular propagation twin using public Ottawa geometry, terrain and spectrum-site data.
Uses Sionna RT / GPU ray tracing, FastAPI and a React/MapLibre/deck.gl browser UI.

Repository documents 14,321 buildings, 2,198,554 triangles, 812 sector-frequency records, a 4x4 km 5 m demo, 64 tiles, nine bands from 635 to 3820 MHz, and 576/576 dual-GPU jobs completed in 553 s on two RTX 3070 GPUs.

projects.name: Skate 3 Rust — macOS Apple Silicon
facts: Native ARM64 macOS port/continuation of upstream open-source SK8-ENGINE work.
Uses Rust, Bevy, SDL3 and Metal.
Do not describe this as Arman creating the original upstream engine.

projects.name: GSANet-DCNN
facts: Guided slot-attention architecture for unsupervised video object segmentation across spatial, temporal and optical-flow features.
Uses PyTorch, RAFT, Slot Attention and Transformers.

facts: LLM-assisted GitHub analytics, automated PR review, developer analysis and productivity dashboards.
